methodology.controlled: 12 actual scenario/player-faction combinations × 3 casualty outcomes, with contemporary new identities, controlled resources and adjacent defenders, shortened route segments, real commands and save validation at every stage. Two controlled year-end snapshots × two seeds per combination; skipped days are not simulated.
methodology.natural: 24 unchanged-opening campaigns × 90 days. Two fixed seeds per combination, real routes, resources, NPC autonomy and tactical AI. Player policy searches and assigns affordable typed reserves in its capital, then uses the existing adjacent-city campaign bot. Every step is saved, decoded and compared.
methodology.limitations: Implementation regression, not campaign balance acceptance or human playtesting. Controlled recruitment relocates an existing contemporary new officer; natural replays retain historical placement. No save migration.
